description: This file defines the Java interface 'WithId', which associates an entity with an identifier. It provides methods to obtain the entity's ID, including a deprecated method returning a String and the preferred method returning an 'EntityId' object.

classes.name: WithId
classes.description: An interface for entities associated with an identifier, providing methods to retrieve the entity's ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the entity's ID as a String, deprecated in favor of getEntityId().

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity's ID as an EntityId object.
